model_requirement: The regional NLSWE state is U=[h,qx,qy]^T with q=h u.
implementation_route: RegionalConservedState and ShallowWaterState store depth, momentum_x, momentum_y.
finding: The implementation uses the same conserved variables and wet-state primitive recovery.
recommended_action: Keep as baseline.

model_requirement: Free-surface elevation is eta=h+b with bed elevation positive upward.
implementation_route: FreeSurfaceElevation and snapshot/export writers compute/store bed_elevation and free_surface_elevation.
finding: The sign convention and eta relation are preserved in state preparation, snapshots, and coupling export.
recommended_action: Keep eta=h+b explicit in future case evidence.

model_requirement: dh/dt + div(q)=source-free mass evolution except boundary/relaxation terms.
implementation_route: Well-balanced finite-volume residual updates depth by net face mass flux and relaxation source where configured.
finding: The continuous conservation law is implemented as a conservative cell residual.
recommended_action: Proceed with numerical method changes as discretisation work.

model_requirement: dqx/dt and dqy/dt use advective momentum flux, hydrostatic pressure, bed slope, friction, optional Coriolis, and relaxation.
implementation_route: Normal flux, hydrostatic reconstruction, local sources, and relaxation residual jointly implement the momentum balance.
finding: Momentum physics are represented through standard finite-volume operators rather than pointwise Cartesian derivatives.
recommended_action: Numerical-order work may target flux/reconstruction without changing the model.

model_requirement: F(U) and G(U) contain qx, qy, qx^2/h, qx*qy/h, qy^2/h and 0.5*g*h^2 pressure terms.
implementation_route: ShallowWaterFlux evaluates the physical normal flux from U and the unit face normal.
finding: The code evaluates F n_x + G n_y directly, which is the face-normal finite-volume equivalent.
recommended_action: Keep flux changes restricted to numerical flux/reconstruction experiments.

model_requirement: The Rusanov speed is max(|u_n|+sqrt(g h)) over left/right states.
implementation_route: characteristic_signal_speed and maximum_characteristic_signal_speed use the same expression.
finding: The local Lax-Friedrichs wave speed matches the documented baseline.
recommended_action: Keep as reference when testing alternative fluxes.

model_requirement: The baseline numerical flux is local Lax-Friedrichs/Rusanov.
implementation_route: RusanovFlux computes half-sum physical flux minus half alpha state jump.
finding: The documented numerical flux is implemented algebraically.
recommended_action: Retain Rusanov as the frozen reference for convergence comparisons.

model_requirement: Bed source is S_b=[0,-g h b_x,-g h b_y]^T.
implementation_route: Hydrostatic reconstruction uses b_f=max(b_L,b_R) and pressure corrections in the residual.
finding: The bed slope is not differenced as a raw gradient; it is represented by a well-balanced hydrostatic discretisation.
impact: No physics mismatch; this is the accepted discrete equivalent.
recommended_action: Keep lake-at-rest tests as mandatory evidence for changes.

model_requirement: Manning bottom friction damps qx and qy as -g n_M^2 q |q| / h^(7/3) in wet cells.
implementation_route: RegionalSourceUpdate computes k=g*n^2/h^(7/3), rate=k*|q|, and scales momentum by 1/(1+k|q|dt).
finding: The update is a semi-implicit exact damping form for the same algebraic source direction.
recommended_action: Document the semi-implicit source discretisation in numerical-method notes.

model_requirement: Coriolis may be included for sufficiently long propagation scales.
implementation_route: Coriolis source fields and rotation update exist, but the Kamaishi/frozen-terrain baseline disables them.
finding: The optional term is implemented but not active in accepted C1A/G6 baselines.
impact: No blocker because the model marks Coriolis optional.
recommended_action: Keep disabled unless event/domain evidence requires it.

model_requirement: Lateral eddy viscosity is not part of the baseline regional source model.
implementation_route: No explicit lateral viscosity source is active; numerical diffusion comes only from the flux.
finding: The source catalogue explicitly excludes lateral eddy viscosity from the baseline.
evidence: docs/workstream/RES - Research/RES-MOD - Mathematical Model and Coupling/RES-MOD-SRC - Physical Source Terms and Constitutive Closures/res-mod-src.tex:409; src/r2d/src/RusanovFlux.cpp:15
recommended_action: Do not conflate Rusanov numerical diffusion with a physical eddy-viscosity closure.

model_requirement: Some RES-MOD text names dynamic moving-bed earthquake bathymetry, while the consolidated selected baseline permits static passive transfer.
implementation_route: The implementation applies effective displacement during initialization and then advances a fixed post-event bathymetry.
finding: There is a wording conflict between older RES-MOD source text and accepted G6/consolidated baseline evidence.
evidence: docs/workstream/RES - Research/RES-MOD - Mathematical Model and Coupling/RES-MOD-SRC - Physical Source Terms and Constitutive Closures/res-mod-src.tex:495; docs/Latex/Proposed Model/studentship_consolidated_mathematical_model_v1.0.tex:362; src/r2d/src/RegionalEarthquakeInitialisation.cpp:550; docs/workstream/wbs-reconciliation/g6_theoretical_model_gate.md:22
impact: Documentation ambiguity only; accepted implementation decision is unambiguous.
recommended_action: Update RES-MOD-SRC to state instantaneous passive initial transfer is current baseline and dynamic moving bed is deferred.

model_requirement: The simplest selected baseline maps finite-fault-derived vertical seabed displacement to eta(x,y,0).
implementation_route: surface_perturbation copies effective_bed_displacement unless a prescribed surface is supplied.
finding: The code implements the accepted passive transfer baseline.
impact: No earthquake-source mismatch for the accepted baseline.
recommended_action: Keep dynamic rupture as a separate future feature, not a hidden model requirement.

model_requirement: After source initialization, terrain is fixed for propagation; q starts from zero.
implementation_route: The initializer constructs post-event bathymetry, post-event depth, and zero post_qx/post_qy.
finding: The propagation model starts from the expected passive earthquake initial condition.
recommended_action: Keep source metadata in case outputs to prevent double-application.

model_requirement: Offshore/source, inland/outflow, and artificial lateral boundaries should be open/radiation; laterals must not be rigid coastal walls.
implementation_route: Regional boundary overrides provide transmissive and characteristic radiation states; relaxation zones can damp artificial boundaries.
finding: The baseline boundary roles are implemented through characteristic exterior states plus optional sponge residuals.
recommended_action: Keep reflection tests tied to boundary policy changes.

model_requirement: S_r=-sigma(x)(U-U_ref), with sigma zero in the interior and increasing through the sponge.
implementation_route: RegionalRelaxationZone adds area*rate*(current-reference) to the residual, yielding damping in the update.
finding: The sign convention is consistent with residual-form explicit updates.
recommended_action: Keep profile parameters in case evidence.

model_requirement: The consolidated model leaves exact radiation condition and sponge profile unresolved pending reflection tests.
implementation_route: Characteristic radiation and relaxation parameters are selected in implementation and supported by accepted G6 evidence.
finding: The implementation is accepted, but the consolidated text still describes this as unresolved.
impact: Documentation ambiguity only; not a mathematical mismatch.
recommended_action: Update model text to cite the accepted characteristic/open-ocean damped policies.

model_requirement: Dry cells use h<h_dry, avoid division by vanishing depth, enforce nonnegative depths, and control momentum.
implementation_route: Hydrostatic reconstruction clips depths and WetDryUpdate/PositivityTimestep enforce admissible updates.
finding: The required wet/dry behavior is represented by discrete positivity and canonicalisation rules.
recommended_action: Maintain shoreline regression tests before changing reconstruction.

model_requirement: The numerical formulation should begin with piecewise-constant states for verification.
implementation_route: Current Regional2D residual uses cell-local owner/neighbour states with hydrostatic reconstruction.
finding: This is the accepted low-order baseline used by the frozen-terrain convergence evidence.
impact: The R6 non-convergence diagnosis is a numerical-method limitation, not a model mismatch.
recommended_action: Treat higher-order reconstruction as a scheme improvement.

model_requirement: Limited linear reconstruction may be introduced after constant/linear manufactured-field evidence.
implementation_route: No production MUSCL/limited-gradient Regional2D solver is active in the baseline.
finding: The model text frames this as a later numerical upgrade, not a required physical model feature.
impact: This is the intended next numerical scheme improvement area.
recommended_action: Proceed only as a numerical-discretisation change with frozen physics and terrain.

model_requirement: The baseline uses explicit FE for component tests and SSPRK2/SSPRK3 for production.
implementation_route: RegionalTimeIntegration supports FE, SSPRK2, and SSPRK3 with stable timestep checks.
finding: The documented explicit time-integration family is implemented.
recommended_action: Temporal-convergence work remains separate from spatial scheme changes.

model_requirement: A gravity-wave CFL timestep is used, with additional source/relaxation restrictions.
implementation_route: CflTimestep, PositivityTimestep, RegionalSourceTimestep, and RelaxationTimestep estimates are combined.
finding: The implementation uses the documented timestep controls in discrete form.
recommended_action: Preserve timestep policy when isolating spatial convergence.

model_requirement: The model solve sequence allows accepting a step or reducing dt and retrying.
implementation_route: attempt_regional_explicit_step returns accepted or retry_with_smaller_timestep based on stable estimates.
finding: The retry machinery is an implementation robustness mechanism around the explicit model.
recommended_action: Keep retry diagnostics out of physical-parameter invariance checks.

model_requirement: The regional shallow-water pressure and wave speed use gravitational acceleration g.
implementation_route: Case policy sets gravity_m_per_s2=9.80665 for Kamaishi and C1A frozen-terrain baselines.
finding: The accepted baseline parameter is explicitly configured.
recommended_action: Keep gravity frozen for spatial-method experiments.

model_requirement: Manning coefficients are case-data inputs; spatial variation is unresolved.
implementation_route: Accepted Kamaishi and frozen-terrain baselines use uniform n=0.025.
finding: Uniform roughness is a case-data simplification within the documented input space.
recommended_action: Do not vary roughness in frozen spatial-convergence studies.

model_requirement: The regional model exports h, eta, qx, qy, and b along the local inlet section.
implementation_route: Coupling exporter writes metadata and samples with depth, momentum_x, momentum_y, bed_elevation, free_surface_elevation.
finding: The export contract contains the required handoff variables.
recommended_action: Keep contract_version increments for future schema changes.

model_requirement: Regional q is projected onto the local inlet normal and tangential directions.
implementation_route: openfoam_replay computes qn and qt from momentum_x/y and configured normal/tangent vectors.
finding: The projection matches the one-way coupling operator.
recommended_action: Retain projection diagnostics for replay regression tests.

model_requirement: A depth-uniform vertical inlet profile is the simplest shallow-water-consistent baseline.
implementation_route: Replay conversion requires mapping.velocity_profile=depth_uniform and sets vertical_velocity to the configured value, defaulting to zero.
finding: The implementation uses the documented simplest baseline and rescales to preserve discrete discharge over wet faces.
recommended_action: Document depth-uniform lift as accepted, not merely unresolved.

model_requirement: alpha_in is 1 below eta_R and 0 above eta_R, with a resolved transition across local interface cells.
implementation_route: Replay conversion computes per-face alpha fractions from eta, bed elevation, and vertical face bounds.
finding: The discrete face-fraction mapping is the finite-volume equivalent of the Heaviside alpha rule.
recommended_action: Keep alpha bounds tests for replay changes.

model_requirement: The inlet mapping preserves section-integrated normal discharge.
implementation_route: Replay conversion records target and reconstructed normal/tangential discharge residuals.
finding: The implementation preserves discharge in the discrete support/face quadrature used by the local inlet.
recommended_action: Use residual diagnostics as replay acceptance evidence.

model_requirement: Regional-to-local coupling is one-way; local reflections are not fed back to Regional2D.
implementation_route: OpenFOAM replay consumes archived Regional2D boundaryData and never updates Regional2D state.
finding: The implementation matches the accepted one-way coupling assumption.
recommended_action: Keep two-way coupling deferred unless reflection evidence requires it.

model_requirement: The local model solves incompressible immiscible two-phase Navier-Stokes/URANS with VOF.
implementation_route: OpenFOAM Foundation 11 incompressibleVoF dictionaries are generated by openfoam_replay.
finding: The repository configures an adopted solver backend for the documented equations.
recommended_action: Keep backend/version authority records with future OpenFOAM changes.

model_requirement: The physical alpha equation is advective and bounded between 0 and 1.
implementation_route: OpenFOAM alpha.water transport is configured and post-run acceptance checks bound alpha.
finding: The adopted backend implements bounded finite-volume VOF transport.
recommended_action: Keep alpha boundedness acceptance checks.

model_requirement: The finite-volume VOF implementation adds bounded interface compression.
implementation_route: OpenFOAM incompressibleVoF provides the production compressive VOF implementation.
finding: Compression is a documented numerical extension of the physical alpha advection equation.
recommended_action: Do not interpret compression as an additional physical phase source.

model_requirement: The selected turbulence baseline is Menter k-omega SST URANS.
implementation_route: Generated OpenFOAM momentumTransport sets simulationType RAS and model kOmegaSST.
finding: The configured turbulence model matches the selected local closure.
recommended_action: Keep LES comparison deferred.

model_requirement: Mixture properties depend on alpha for water and air density/viscosity.
implementation_route: Generated OpenFOAM phaseProperties and physicalProperties files configure water and air phases.
finding: The backend receives the required two-phase material-property configuration.
recommended_action: Record any future material calibration separately.

model_requirement: The local inlet is forced by one-way regional replay.
implementation_route: Generated U and alpha.water inlet patches use timeVaryingMappedFixedValue from boundaryData.
finding: The local inlet receives the mapped regional time series through OpenFOAM native boundaryData.
recommended_action: Keep one-way inlet as immutable when testing Regional2D scheme changes.

model_requirement: The local outlet is open/radiation with absorption where required.
implementation_route: Production replay uses pressureInletOutletVelocity, prghTotalPressure p0=0, variableHeightFlowRate, turbulence inletOutlet, and outlet isotropicDamping.
finding: The selected OpenFOAM open-ocean policy implements the intended outlet role.
recommended_action: Keep reflection coefficients in boundary-policy evidence.

model_requirement: Artificial side boundaries represent continuation of the ocean/coastal field and are not rigid walls.
implementation_route: Production replay uses open-ocean field conditions and lateral isotropicDamping zones; legacy symmetry remains only for schema 1.0.0 fixtures.
finding: The accepted production policy matches the documented physical role.
recommended_action: Do not regress production laterals to rigid or symmetry-only behavior.

model_requirement: The top boundary is open atmosphere with reference pressure and suitable phase/velocity treatment.
implementation_route: Generated atmosphere patch uses open velocity/pressure/alpha policies.
finding: The OpenFOAM boundary choices implement the intended open atmospheric role.
recommended_action: Keep top boundary policy in generated boundary_policy.json.

model_requirement: Fixed terrain/topography is impermeable with wall shear treatment.
implementation_route: Generated terrain wall fields use noSlip, fixedFluxPressure, zeroGradient alpha, and wall functions.
finding: The OpenFOAM wall policy implements fixed terrain with wall-shear closure.
recommended_action: Keep wall-function evidence with production Local3D runs.

model_requirement: The barrier is a fixed rigid obstacle with pressure and viscous traction extraction.
implementation_route: Generated barrier patch is a wall and enables the OpenFOAM forces function object when present.
finding: The rigid-wall local model is implemented through OpenFOAM wall patches and forces extraction.
recommended_action: Keep deformable/porous barriers out of current baseline claims.

model_requirement: Hydrodynamic loading is extracted from pressure and viscous tractions on the barrier.
implementation_route: OpenFOAM forces function object is configured over the barrier patch.
finding: Integrated force/moment extraction is available, while full load convergence remains a verification task.
impact: No model mismatch; downstream validation remains open.
recommended_action: Do not require full force convergence before Regional2D spatial-scheme work.

model_requirement: Local3D uses adaptive timestep/CFL controls for stable VOF evolution.
implementation_route: Generated controlDict and timestep_policy evidence configure maxCo, maxAlphaCo, and maxDeltaT policy around OpenFOAM controls.
finding: The local solver timestep policy is implemented through backend configuration and repository evidence.
impact: No blocker for Regional2D spatial work.
recommended_action: Keep formal Local3D timestep convergence deferred.

model_requirement: Two-way coupling is necessary only if local reflection materially changes the incident regional field.
implementation_route: No two-way Regional2D feedback path is implemented.
finding: The model explicitly accepts one-way replay as the current baseline.
recommended_action: Revisit only if reflection/placement evidence invalidates one-way replay.

model_requirement: LES may be used as a later high-fidelity comparison.
implementation_route: The implemented operational local baseline is URANS k-omega SST.
finding: LES is outside the G6/C1A accepted baseline.
recommended_action: Keep LES in future verification/validation planning.

model_requirement: FSI, deformable structures, damage, scour, and full impact metrics are outside the current gate.
implementation_route: No FSI/damage/scour solver is implemented.
finding: These features are excluded from the accepted theoretical-model gate.
impact: No blocker for numerical scheme work.
recommended_action: Keep excluded features out of model-consistency acceptance criteria.

model_requirement: No dispersive regional baseline is selected.
implementation_route: Regional2D implements NLSWE, not Boussinesq/dispersive propagation.
finding: Dispersive physics are a future model extension, not a missing required term.
recommended_action: Do not introduce dispersive terms as part of spatial-order repairs.
